info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Merchant Relationship Management API
info.description: The Merchant Relationship Management API facilitates the enhancement and administration of partnerships with merchants. It allows businesses to onboard new merchants, manage existing relationships, and streamline communication between parties. The API is designed for financial institutions and service providers looking to optimize their merchant interactions and ensure smooth transactional operations. Use cases include integrating merchant data, tracking performance metrics, and facilitating support requests.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to establish a new relationship with a merchant. It requires the necessary details about the merchant and the parameters needed to create the relation.
